in_hebrew.name: Lesli
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Lesli הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name 'Lesbos', meaning 'meadow', 'plain' or 'island'. In Greek mythology, Lesbos is the name of an island in the Aegean Sea. Lesli is a popular name in Christian and Western cultures, carrying a spiritual connection to nature and the divine.
